unmet_needs.ask: Granular, revocable sharing and caregiver participation before and after visits.
Confirmed tasks, medication reconciliation, reminders, and between-visit check-ins.
Unify relevant notes, labs, images, device data, and follow-up questions.
Consent workflow, policy checks, audit trail, and control over downstream use.
Citations, uncertainty cues, concise output, and clinician review where needed.
A single timeline for symptoms, photos, decisions, tasks, and unresolved questions.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I kind of go dumb when they start talking.
evidence_ledger.supports: Stress and overload reduce in-visit comprehension and recall.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: It is hard to search things.
evidence_ledger.supports: Users need searchable key points rather than another long record.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Sometimes I can't think of the questions at the time.
evidence_ledger.supports: Questions often emerge after the appointment.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: What to expect beforehand, what to ask.
evidence_ledger.supports: Patients already seek preparation and question prompts.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Understanding results, what they mean.
evidence_ledger.supports: Test results and borderline values create interpretation needs.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Show me the citations from research.
evidence_ledger.supports: Some users need transparent sources, not unsupported AI answers.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Documentation between visits.
evidence_ledger.supports: Users want continuity across appointments, not isolated summaries.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: My family will have follow-up questions.
evidence_ledger.supports: Visit information must often be relayed to absent family.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: What are your top three questions?
evidence_ledger.supports: Question support should prioritize a short agenda.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Written medication list, questions and concerns, recent vital signs.
evidence_ledger.supports: Preparation needs concrete documents and data.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Depends on education level, medical literacy, anxiety, cognitive status.
evidence_ledger.supports: Communication needs are multi-dimensional and encounter-specific.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: It would have to be a must that we see the summary.
evidence_ledger.supports: Some settings require review before patient release.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: For me to write three lines is faster than reviewing four lines for errors.
evidence_ledger.supports: Review burden can erase the product's workflow value.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Presence or engagement of a care partner is instrumental.
evidence_ledger.supports: Care partners are a core communication support for high-need patients.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: A thousand pages, but only two usable ones.
evidence_ledger.supports: The problem is relevant-record selection, not merely record collection.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Maybe they remember but do not execute the plan.
evidence_ledger.supports: Understanding alone does not ensure follow-through.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I write everything down ahead of time to remember it.
evidence_ledger.supports: Patients already create their own preparation scaffolding.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I forgot all the technical terms.
evidence_ledger.supports: Terminology is a comprehension and recall barrier.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I go in with a list of questions, but often forget while listening.
evidence_ledger.supports: A prepared list still needs in-visit prioritization support.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I often feel overwhelmed with the amount of information shared.
evidence_ledger.supports: Explanation needs change with encounter load.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: I feel better knowing someone else is there to absorb information.
evidence_ledger.supports: A care partner provides both recall support and reassurance.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Multiple apps and portals have my medical data.
evidence_ledger.supports: Records are fragmented across systems and formats.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: It would be better to keep a more detailed list of symptoms.
evidence_ledger.supports: Users want dated, event-level symptom history.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Cannot keep track of it due to executive dysfunction.
evidence_ledger.supports: Tracking must reduce executive-function demands.

evidence_ledger.source_ref: Clinicians sheet rows 19 and 21 duplicate pair
evidence_ledger.excerpt: What are you taking, and why are you taking it?
evidence_ledger.supports: Medication lists need purpose and reconciliation, not names alone.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: The report is only a statement; we need to see the image.
evidence_ledger.supports: Some decisions require original clinical artifacts.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: AI can be over-inclusive and has to be succinct.
evidence_ledger.supports: Research support must filter for relevance and currency.

data_quality.issue: Accessible sample differs from recalled fieldwork totals
data_quality.evidence: 165 patient rows (164 unique submissions), 4 separate patient interview rows, and 21 clinician rows were accessible.
data_quality.impact: The report describes the connected corpus, not the larger recalled total of 200–300 surveys, 50 user interviews, and 30–50 clinicians.

data_quality.evidence: Several later columns have only 53–59 responses; early fields have 119–165.
data_quality.impact: Every percentage uses its own non-null denominator.

data_quality.evidence: Most structured clinician questions have only 1–8 answers.
data_quality.impact: Clinician percentages are descriptive of field respondents only.

data_quality.evidence: Most patient records came through Reddit; interviewees have high chronic-care exposure.
data_quality.impact: Theme counts show frequency in this corpus, not population prevalence.

data_quality.evidence: The interest question combines recording, transcript, and tailored questions.
data_quality.impact: It cannot isolate demand for one feature.

data_quality.issue: PII and credentials present in source files
data_quality.evidence: Contact fields and a separate operational tracker contain sensitive information.
data_quality.impact: Raw exports are excluded; only de-identified aggregates and excerpts are written.
